mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DM_MESSAGE (DM_ID, SENDER_EMPNO, RECEIVER_EMPNO, SENDER_NAME, CONTENT, SENT_AT) VALUES (DM_MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{senderEmpno}, #{receiverEmpno}, #{senderName}, #{content}, SYSDATE + 9/24)
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN SENDER_EMPNO = #{myEmpno} THEN RECEIVER_EMPNO ELSE SENDER_EMPNO END AS PARTNER_EMPNO FROM DM_MESSAGE WHERE SENDER_EMPNO = #{myEmpno} OR RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{myEmpno} GROUP BY CASE WHEN SENDER_EMPNO = #{myEmpno} THEN RECEIVER_EMPNO ELSE SENDER_EMPNO END ORDER BY MAX(DM_ID) DESC

SELECT DM_ID, SENDER_EMPNO, RECEIVER_EMPNO, SENDER_NAME, CONTENT, TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT FROM ( SELECT * FROM DM_MESSAGE WHERE (SENDER_EMPNO = #{empno1} AND RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{empno2}) OR (SENDER_EMPNO = #{empno2} AND RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{empno1}) ORDER BY DM_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit} ORDER BY DM_ID ASC
